title: Oscillating cylinder (AMReX plotfile)
author: Mahesh Natarajan, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
extraction: Native AMReX final timestep read by the public yt API. Only the y velocity scalar is retained as little-endian float64 gzip blocks, without spatial cropping or sample rescaling. The Header is retained byte for byte. Adjacent same-level blocks are losslessly packed into larger rectangular blocks, with each source block ID recorded. No coarse block is upsampled.
